behaviorChanges: Core guidance requires a fresh-context self-review followed by a different-model-family review, with direct verification of fixes and no repeated review loop.
Shared manifests retain bounded recent history and reconcile removed claims without consuming a lifetime task quota. Private retired text is not automatically published.

optionalMigrations.description: Refresh generated adapters. For handwritten adapters, manually add the core two-review instruction from docs/reference/reviews.md; slim preserves already-lean handwritten files.

rollbackNotes: Active local and shared manifests remain compatible with 0.150.0. Older versions do not list records moved into the local retired directory; existing Git history is preserved. Returning to an older runtime restores its previous synchronization and review-guidance behavior.
